title: Barcelona defender arrives late to Hansi Flick’s team talk ahead of Sabah clash
tweet: Kounde arrived a few moments after Flick’s opening talk, drawing a frown from the German manager. No visible fallout followed, and he has already re‑earned a spot in the squad after his ankle return. He could start tomorrow against Sabah, but whether he takes the field remains to be seen.

title: Barcelona homegrown star’s future could become clearer after Sabah clash
tweet: Balde has logged only 124 minutes this season; a start against Sabah would be the clearest sign Flick is willing to give him a role. If he is again left out, it would reinforce doubts about his place in the squad moving forward.

title: Three talking points ahead of Sabah vs Barcelona | UEFA Champions League
tweet: Lamine Yamal will miss the Baku clash, forcing Flick to shuffle the front three. Fatigue from a 4,000‑km trip and a tight calendar make a quick win a priority, so the German may lean on fringe stars for the first six minutes. As things stand, the match looks like a chance to preserve key players for the City test.
